identification.name: NO_6^-(2) graph

theorem: The 36-spread four-line intersection graph is the standard rank-three NO_6^-(2) graph, equivalently NO_5^{-perp}(3). A fixed vertex has local graph Kneser K(6,2) and second subconstituent Johnson J(6,3), and the full automorphism group has order 51,840.

why_parameter_matching_is_insufficient.literature_boundary: The graph and its standard names are prior art; the repository contribution is the literal identification of its 36 spread vertices and incidence-derived adjacency.
